points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 拿破仑出生于科西嘉岛的一个意大利裔贵族家庭，当时科西嘉岛刚被法国收购。他的家庭属于当地小贵族，但经济状况并不富裕。拿破仑在法语学校接受教育，但始终保持着科西嘉人的身份认同。这段经历塑造了他对法国既向往又疏离的复杂情感，也培养了他对权力的渴望和对自身出身的敏感。他的童年和青少年时期充满了对法国既依赖又反抗的矛盾心理，这种矛盾成为他后来政治生涯的重要心理基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Ajaccio, Corsica, to a family of minor Italian nobility shortly after the island was annexed by France, Napoleon's early years were marked by a complex relationship with France. He was educated in French schools but maintained a Corsican identity. This upbringing created a duality in his character - both attracted to and resentful of French authority. His family's modest financial status and the island's recent acquisition by France shaped his ambition and sensitivity about his origins, which would later influence his political career and military strategies.

points.title: 军校与革命
points.description: 1785年，拿破仑从军校毕业，成为一名炮兵少尉。在大革命期间，他积极支持革命，并凭借其军事才能迅速崭露头角。1793年，他在土伦战役中表现出色，成功使用炮火战术击败保皇党军队，被破格提拔为准将。这一时期，拿破仑展现了非凡的军事才能和政治敏锐度，他善于把握革命时机，同时也开始形成自己的政治理念。他在巴黎社交圈中建立了人脉网络，为日后的崛起奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After graduating from military academy in 1785 as a second lieutenant in artillery, Napoleon embraced the French Revolution. His military genius became evident during the Siege of Toulon in 1793, where his innovative artillery tactics led to a decisive victory over royalist forces, resulting in his promotion to brigadier general. During this period, he developed both his military skills and political acumen, building crucial connections in Parisian circles that would later support his rise to power. His ability to seize opportunities during the revolutionary chaos began to manifest.

points.title: 军事征服
points.description: 1796年，拿破仑被任命为意大利方面军总司令，在意大利战役中取得辉煌胜利，迫使奥地利签订《坎波福尔米奥条约》。1798年，他远征埃及，虽然最终军事失败，但通过金字塔战役等战斗建立了军事声誉。在埃及期间，他组织了科学考察，发现了罗塞塔石碑，对埃及学有重要贡献。这一时期的军事成功使拿破仑成为法国最受欢迎的英雄，也为他日后夺取政权积累了政治资本和军事经验。他的意大利战役展示了卓越的战略战术，而埃及远征则体现了他对科学和文化的兴趣。
points.descriptionEn: As commander of the French army in Italy (1796-97), Napoleon achieved spectacular victories against Austrian and Sardinian forces, culminating in the Treaty of Campo Formio. His Italian campaign demonstrated his military genius through innovative tactics and effective use of propaganda. In 1798, he led the Egyptian expedition, which, though ultimately a military failure, enhanced his reputation through battles like the Battle of the Pyramids. During this campaign, he organized scientific expeditions and discovered the Rosetta Stone, contributing to Egyptology. These campaigns solidified his status as France's most popular hero and provided the political capital and military experience that would enable his rise to power.

points.title: 执掌帝国
points.description: 1799年，拿破仑发动雾月政变，成为第一执政，开始了他的独裁统治。1804年，他加冕为法兰西皇帝，建立了法兰西第一帝国。在巴黎统治期间，拿破仑推行了一系列重要改革，包括《拿破仑法典》、中央集权的行政体系、法兰西银行等，这些改革对现代法国乃至欧洲法律和政治制度产生了深远影响。他通过战争征服了大部分欧洲大陆，建立了拿破仑同盟体系。然而，他的统治也伴随着战争、征兵和经济压力，导致国内不满情绪增长。1812年，他发动对俄国的灾难性远征，成为帝国衰落的转折点。
points.descriptionEn: In Paris, Napoleon launched the Coup of 18 Brumaire in 1799, becoming First Consul and establishing his dictatorship. In 1804, he crowned himself Emperor of the French, establishing the First French Empire. During his rule in Paris, he implemented transformative reforms including the Napoleonic Code, centralized administrative system, and the Bank of France, which profoundly influenced modern French and European legal and political systems. Through military campaigns, he conquered most of continental Europe and established the Napoleonic system of alliances. However, his rule was marked by constant warfare, conscription, and economic pressures, leading to growing domestic discontent. The disastrous invasion of Russia in 1812 marked the beginning of the empire's decline.

points.title: 流放与归来
points.description: 1814年，拿破仑在莱比锡战役和法俄战争后战败，被迫退位，被流放到厄尔巴岛。在厄尔巴岛，他保留了皇帝头衔，统治着这个小岛，并密切注视法国局势。1815年，他逃离厄尔巴岛，返回法国，开始了著名的'百日王朝'。他沿途受到民众热烈欢迎，路易十八的军队纷纷倒戈。这一时期展现了拿破仑非凡的个人魅力和政治影响力，即使在失败后，他仍能迅速重掌权力。然而，百日王朝最终在滑铁卢战役中彻底结束，标志着他政治生涯的终结。
points.descriptionEn: After his defeat in the Battle of Leipzig and the disastrous Russian campaign, Napoleon was forced to abdicate in 1814 and exiled to the island of Elba. There, he retained the title of Emperor and ruled the small island while closely monitoring French affairs. In 1815, he escaped from Elba and returned to France, beginning the famous 'Hundred Days'. During this period, he was greeted with popular enthusiasm, and many of Louis XVIII's troops defected to his side. This phase demonstrated Napoleon's extraordinary personal charisma and political influence, as he quickly regained power even after defeat. However, the Hundred Days ended with his final defeat at the Battle of Waterloo, marking the end of his political career.

points.title: 最终流放
points.description: 滑铁卢战役失败后，拿破仑被英国流放到遥远的圣赫勒拿岛。在这座孤岛上，他度过了生命的最后六年，受到严格的监视。期间，他口述了回忆录，为自己的统治辩护，并塑造了自己的传奇形象。1821年5月5日，拿破仑在圣赫勒拿岛去世，死因有胃癌砒霜中毒等多种说法。他的遗体于1840年被运回法国，以国葬仪式安葬在巴黎荣军院。圣赫勒拿岛的流放生涯成为拿破仑传奇的最后一章，他的死亡和身后之事进一步巩固了他在历史上的传奇地位。
points.descriptionEn: After his final defeat at Waterloo, Napoleon was exiled by the British to the remote island of Saint Helena, where he spent the last six years of his life under strict surveillance. During this exile, he dictated his memoirs, defending his rule and shaping his own legend. Napoleon died on May 5, 1821, with causes of death ranging from stomach cancer to arsenic poisoning. His remains were returned to France in 1840 and buried with honors in the Les Invalides in Paris. This final exile became the last chapter of Napoleon's legend, and his death and subsequent events further cemented his iconic status in history.

appraisal.zh: 史学界一般认为，拿破仑既是法国大革命的继承者也是其终结者，既奠定现代国家制度又代表专制统治，其遗产复杂而矛盾：《拿破仑法典》与行政改革塑造了现代欧洲国家，战争则重划了欧洲政治版图。也有研究者指出，其独裁统治与持续战争造成大量死亡，压制言论自由、恢复奴隶制，个人野心凌驾于人民福祉之上。正因功过如此悬殊，他成为人类集体想象中天才与暴君并存的重要符号。
appraisal.en: Historians generally regard Napoleon as both heir and ender of the French Revolution, a founder of modern state institutions and a symbol of authoritarian rule, his legacy complex and contradictory: the Napoleonic Code and administrative reforms shaped modern European states, while his wars redrew the political map of Europe. Yet other scholars point to his authoritarian rule and continuous wars that caused many deaths, his suppression of free speech and reinstatement of slavery, with personal ambition overriding the people's welfare. It is precisely this stark disparity that makes him a symbol of both genius and tyranny in the collective imagination.

supporter.zh: 支持者视拿破仑为伟大的改革者和军事天才，他结束了法国大革命的混乱，建立了稳定的秩序和高效的行政体系。《拿破仑法典》成为现代民法的基石，影响深远。他通过教育和行政改革提升了法国社会地位，促进了民族国家的形成。支持者认为他代表了进步、理性和启蒙理想的实现，尽管手段专制，但其改革精神和对现代国家建设的贡献不可磨灭。
supporter.en: Supporters view Napoleon as a great reformer and military genius who ended the chaos of the French Revolution and established stable order with efficient administration. The Napoleonic Code became the foundation of modern civil law with far-reaching influence. Through educational and administrative reforms, he elevated social status in France and promoted the formation of nation-states. Supporters argue he represented the realization of progressive, rational, and Enlightenment ideals, and despite his authoritarian methods, his reform spirit and contributions to modern state-building are undeniable.

critic.zh: 批评者谴责拿破仑的独裁统治和持续战争导致数百万人死亡，他压制言论自由，恢复奴隶制，并通过专制手段维持权力。他的征服战争虽然传播了革命理念，但也带来了民族压迫和反抗。批评者认为他背叛了革命理想，建立了比旧制度更专制的统治，其个人野心凌驾于人民福祉之上。他的帝国建立在军事征服基础上，缺乏持久性，最终导致了欧洲的长期动荡。
critic.en: Critics condemn Napoleon's authoritarian rule and continuous wars that resulted in hundreds of thousands of deaths. They accuse him of suppressing freedom of speech, reinstating slavery, and maintaining power through autocratic means. While his conquests spread revolutionary ideas, they also brought national oppression and resistance. Critics argue he betrayed revolutionary ideals, establishing a regime more authoritarian than the old system, with personal ambition superseding the welfare of the people. His empire, built on military conquest, lacked sustainability and ultimately led to long-term European instability.

objective.zh: 客观历史视角下，拿破仑是欧洲历史上最具影响力也最具争议的人物之一。他既是法国大革命的继承者，也是其终结者；既是现代国家制度的奠基人，也是专制统治的代表。他的遗产复杂而矛盾：一方面，《拿破仑法典》和行政改革塑造了现代欧洲国家；另一方面，他的战争改变了欧洲政治版图。在流行文化中，拿破仑常被浪漫化为天才或暴君的象征，反映了人们对权力、野心和历史变革的复杂态度。他的传奇超越了历史事实，成为人类集体想象中的重要符号。
objective.en: From an objective historical perspective, Napoleon stands as one of the most influential yet controversial figures in European history. He was both an heir and an ender of the French Revolution; both a founder of modern state institutions and a symbol of authoritarian rule. His legacy is complex and contradictory: on one hand, the Napoleonic Code and administrative reforms shaped modern European states; on the other, his wars redrew the political map of Europe. In popular culture, Napoleon is often romanticized as a symbol of genius or tyranny, reflecting humanity's complex attitudes toward power, ambition, and historical transformation. His legend transcends historical facts, becoming an important symbol in collective imagination.

self.zh: 不可能的事，如果我去尝试，就变成了可能。
self.en: Impossible is a word to be found only in the dictionary of fools.
